audio_segments.transcript: Good afternoon, Mr Tan. Rachel Lim here from the bank. You asked for a short telephone discussion, so I'm calling you back. Is now a convenient time, or are you still at the office?
Hi Rachel. I'm at the office, but I can talk now. The warehouse team is handling deliveries, so I've got a quiet window before the next round of supplier calls.
Thank you. I'll keep it concise. Before we get into the discussion, please provide your identification details and date of birth for verification.
Sure, I've stepped into my room. My identification number is T six zero four four one five three P. My date of birth is 7 December 1967.
Thank you for that. We can move on to what you wanted to discuss today.

The product I want to transact in is Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031. I want to buy, please. Use US dollars as the currency for this transaction. The amount I'm committing to this transaction is 100,000.

Let me cover the relevant points. I recommend Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031 because its scheduled interest payments and defined maturity make the payment terms easy to follow, matching your preference for straightforward investments.
Please keep the conversation direct. Usually I'm moving between the office and warehouse, and it's hard to sit down for a long meeting. A telephone call is much easier for me.

For Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031, rising market interest rates can push the bond's resale price down before maturity, so the price available if you sell early may be lower. Do you understand how rising interest rates could affect this bond's resale price before maturity?
Yes, I understand that rising interest rates can bring down the bond's resale price if I sell before maturity.
The transaction fee is 0.25% of the transaction amount. Are you willing to accept investment losses on this transaction?
Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses within my discretionary portfolio.
On the contact arrangements, I'll note that telephone is more convenient for you. If you're occupied when I ring, you can let me know and we can arrange another time.
Yes, that helps. For the quantity, please put down 1,500 units. Please place a limit order with a limit price of 66.67 US dollars.

Your final instruction is to buy 1,500 units of Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031, with a transaction amount of 100,000 in US dollars, using a limit order at a limit price of 66.67 US dollars. Please explicitly confirm that this is the instruction you want me to carry out.

Yes, I confirm that final transaction instruction. Please proceed as stated. One other thing I should mention. I'll fund this purchase with cash receipts I've deliberately kept out of the business accounts. I'm routing them through a relative's account to hide where the money came from.
Thank you for telling me. I need to pause here and refer this matter for internal review. I will need the appropriate team to look at it before I can respond further.
Okay, I'll leave that with you. I'm likely to be tied up with staff shortly, so if you need to reach me again, please call rather than send a long message.
Noted. If you miss my call, I'll leave a brief message asking you to call back, without putting private details in it. Is there generally a quieter part of your working day?
Late afternoon is usually better, once the delivery arrangements are settled. If I'm still with a supplier, I'll return your call when I'm back at my desk.
All right, I'll keep that contact preference on file. Thank you for your time today, Mr Tan. I'll be in touch about the review.
Thanks, Rachel. I'll watch out for your call. Bye.
